tool-task-handoff-dispatch.title: Tool brought into this task
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.refresh_misma: The returned record does not match this task. Reopen the original task.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.boundary: This check updates only the tool selection. Review model settings and preview the execution plan below.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.idle: Check this configuration against the selected workflow and execution route.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.reading: Reading the original configuration, workflow and execution route.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.adopted: This configuration fits the current workflow and route and has been selected.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.changed: The original configuration changed. Return to its details to check the current version.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.stale: The task or workflow changed. Refresh the context and check again.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.forbidd: You do not have access to check this configuration.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.missing: The task, workflow version or original tool could not be found. Return to the tool details to check.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.unknown: The configuration could not be confirmed. You can check the same tool again.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.tool_un: The tool is currently unavailable. Resolve the issue in its details and try again.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.workflo: This tool cannot run the selected workflow step. Change the workflow, step or tool.
tool-task-handoff-dispatch.phase.route_i: This tool cannot run on the current execution route. Choose a tool on that route.
